meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 02 of 2024 adopting the Final Budget for Fiscal Year 2025 of the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority
votes.description: Approves the FY2025 budget for the LBA's Capital Projects Fund, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries. The LBA is a financing tool allowing cities to bond for capital projects at better interest rates.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the LBA and reconvene as the RDA board
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the Local Building Authority meeting and transition to the Redevelopment Agency board meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 11 of 2024 approving the Fiscal Year 2024 RDA Budget reflected in the attached Key Changes spreadsheet with the clarifications shown on the motion sheet
votes.description: Approves the FY2025 annual budget for the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City, incorporating specific clarifications noted on the motion sheet.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the RDA board and reconvene as the Salt Lake City Council
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the Redevelopment Agency board meeting and transition to the Salt Lake City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the formal meeting minutes of March 26, 2024
votes.description: Approves the official formal meeting minutes from the March 26, 2024 City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 17 of 2024 with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing June 19, 2024 as Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A ceremonial resolution jointly adopted with the Mayor to officially recognize June 19, 2024 as Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City, honoring the history of emancipation.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 18 of 2024 with Mayor Mendenhall celebrating June 20, 2024 as World Refugee Day in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A ceremonial resolution jointly adopted with the Mayor to officially celebrate June 20, 2024 as World Refugee Day in Salt Lake City, recognizing the contributions of refugees to the community.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G-1 through G-4 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: Closes the joint public hearing for four grant applications (Redwood Road Safety, Community Wildfire Defense, First Responders Mental Health, and Emergency Management Performance) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Capital City Revitalization Zone
votes.description: Closes the second public hearing on the proposed Capital City Revitalization Zone, which would potentially facilitate redevelopment around the Delta Center, without taking final action on the ordinance at this meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 46 of 2024 approving Salt Lake City's Fiscal Year 2024-25 budget (excluding Library Fund) as outlined in attached key changes spreadsheets and staffing document, including contingent appropriations for Foothill Trails and Funding Our Future Sales Tax Funds
votes.description: Adopts the main FY2024-25 city operating budget with specified contingencies, including holding Foothills Trail System funds pending stakeholder review and maintaining oversight conditions on Funding Our Future sales tax expenditures.

votes.motion: Adopt $41,643,495 into CIP, including approving $13,468,356 in funding as shown on the motion sheet (Motion #4), in conjunction with Ordinance 46 of 2024
votes.description: Approves the Capital Improvement Program funding allocation of approximately $41.6 million as part of the FY2024-25 budget adoption, including $13.47 million in specific project funding detailed on the motion sheet.

votes.motion: Adopt the Legislative Intent Statements as outlined on the motion sheet (Motion 5, items 1-8), in conjunction with Ordinance 46 of 2024
votes.description: Adopts eight legislative intent statements accompanying the FY2024-25 city budget, providing policy direction to the Administration on various budget-related matters.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 45 of 2024 approving the budget for the Library Fund of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2024-25
votes.description: Adopts the separately enacted FY2024-25 budget for the Salt Lake City Library Fund as required by state law.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 47 of 2024 setting the final rate of tax levy, including the final rate for the Library Fund, upon all real and personal property within Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2024-25, and authorize the Council Chair to sign documentation for the State Tax Commission
votes.description: Sets the FY2024-25 property tax levy at a total rate of 0.003401 per dollar of taxable valuation, allocated among the General Fund, Library Fund, General Obligation Bonds, and Governmental Immunity Fund.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 48 of 2024 (H4), Ordinance 49 of 2024 (H5), Ordinance 50 of 2024 (H6), Ordinance 51 of 2024 (H7), Ordinance 52 of 2024 (H8), and Ordinance 53 of 2024 (H9) relating to the Fiscal Year 2024-25 budget, with a noted procedural gap for executive municipal officers to be addressed at a follow-up public hearing on July 2
votes.description: Adopts six FY2024-25 budget ordinances covering the consolidated fee schedule, non-represented employee compensation plan, AFSCME MOU appropriations, IAFF MOU appropriations, Salt Lake City Police Association MOU appropriations, and compensation adjustment for elected and statutory officers.

Approves all items on the consent agenda, including setting public hearing dates for zoning text and map amendments, CIP funding public hearings, a public hearing for executive municipal officer compensation, and Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 6) for FY2023-24.
